interactions.type: headline picker with reaction time chart
interactions.teaches: Promoters answered the news within days or weeks, and the Iron Sheik is the exception that proves a character can predate its event.
interactions.studentAction: Chooses one of four front pages.
interactions.feedback: The matching news and ring entries appear with the day gap, and that bar lights up on a log scale chart.
interactions.staticFallback: Without JavaScript all four entries and the full chart are visible.
interactions.identityFit: Front page cards and a broadcast style bar chart.

interactions.teaches: Heel and face are roles assigned by promoters and changed by world events or opponents.
interactions.studentAction: Chooses a wrestler, then a year.
interactions.feedback: The role badge flips heel or face and a What changed note explains the cause.
interactions.staticFallback: Without JavaScript every wrestler and every year panel is visible in sequence.
interactions.identityFit: Heel red and face steel chips over archival photographs.

interactions.teaches: The card's villains cluster around a few national fears.
interactions.feedback: Only matching bouts remain and the tally highlights that category's count.
interactions.staticFallback: All fifteen bouts and the full tally are visible.
interactions.identityFit: Fight card chips and a sticky tally board.

interactions.teaches: Nine of eleven heels sold as outsiders were played by men from somewhere else.
interactions.studentAction: Switches between The poster and The record.
interactions.feedback: Every open bout swaps the billed identity for the real one, set in the record's newspaper serif.
interactions.staticFallback: The poster view is shown with record details available in sources.
interactions.identityFit: Kayfabe gold versus record steel, the hub's two channels.

interactions.teaches: The grade rewards history, with 60 of 100 points on questions 2 through 5.
interactions.studentAction: Taps a segment of the 100 point bar.
interactions.feedback: The note names that criterion and what full credit requires.
interactions.staticFallback: The five questions list their points and full credit in expandable rows.
interactions.identityFit: A printed scoring strip on the paper colored mission page.

interactions.teaches: Proving a historical connection requires dates in order.
interactions.studentAction: Places four events from earliest to latest.
interactions.feedback: Each slot is marked right or wrong with its date, and the verdict explains why the Sheik predates the crisis.
interactions.staticFallback: The correct dated order and the verdict are shown.
interactions.identityFit: Plain numbered slots in the arena palette.

interactions.teaches: Previews the documentary the class watches.
interactions.studentAction: Presses play on the Netflix trailer.
interactions.feedback: The official trailer loads in place from YouTube.
interactions.identityFit: Broadcast slate with a red play button.

interactions.teaches: Pairs the real crisis with the match that sold it.
interactions.studentAction: Plays National Archives footage and the 1984 WWE match.
interactions.identityFit: Side by side news and ring slates.

interactions.teaches: Lets students hear wrestlers and WWE describe their own turns.
interactions.studentAction: Plays the WrestleMania VII Playback and the Volkoff tribute.

interactions.teaches: Gives primary video evidence for four heels on the card.
interactions.studentAction: Plays a 1948 newsreel or three WWE segments.
interactions.feedback: Each video loads in place; bout cards link to them.

interactions.teaches: Students compare the wrestler's billed identity with the historical situation, then build original evidence-backed explanations rather than copy an answer.
interactions.studentAction: Choose a heel, draft answers to the five research questions and cite sources in progressively revealed rounds.
interactions.feedback: A live meter identifies which rounds contain substantial drafts; it explicitly does not certify historical accuracy or a grade.
interactions.staticFallback: All five rounds' labels and answer fields remain visible without JavaScript, with the existing assignment rubric still readable.
interactions.identityFit: A ringside case dossier with fight-card rounds and original paper evidence locker.

interactions.teaches: Chronology constrains causal claims; a later event cannot create an earlier character, and an earlier event alone does not prove influence.
interactions.studentAction: Enter the real event date and earliest documented character date, optionally a later promo or match, then compare.
interactions.feedback: The comparison explains the valid chronological inference and flags missing precision, without fabricating exact dates.
interactions.staticFallback: The neighboring Prove the Connection chapter gives a complete dated example and the case file text fields remain usable.
interactions.identityFit: A scored timeline check as part of the investigation.

interactions.teaches: A good history presentation balances an evidence-based claim, accurate research, source reliability, concise delivery and ethical language.
interactions.studentAction: Draft up to three slides, rehearse with an optional timer and self-check the original nine point categories.
interactions.feedback: The timer shows whether the rehearsal was under, within or over two to three minutes; self-checked points remain separate from the teacher's grade.
interactions.staticFallback: The original rubric and rules remain available; slide outlines and source notes are readable without the timer.
interactions.identityFit: Five rounds leading to the final bell, with a judge's scorecard that cannot award grades.
